Ideal for data centers, enterprise server rooms, and office network closets, it enhances cable management efficiency and ensures stable signal transmission.

full_description: LG-F86C-1P (1-port) are premium network wiring faceplates designed for high-standard indoor network cabling systems. Featuring a standard 86×86mm dimension, the faceplates are perfectly compatible with 86-type junction boxes and adopt a sleek, ergonomic design with smooth edges and a flush-mount profile for professional aesthetics. Engineered for easy installation of Cat5e/Cat6/Cat6A network modules (RJ45), they provide a neat, reliable cable outlet solution. With excellent flame retardancy, low smoke emission, zero halogen release and high impact resistance, these faceplates are ideal for residential buildings, commercial offices, hotels, data centers, hospitals and public facilities, ensuring safe and stable signal transmission in various environments.
